title: Rainbow Front Bumper Stickers To Cover Up A Scratch
description: We used custom designed front bumper stickers to cover up a scratch for our client. Read more for our process and before and after pictures.

blocks.text: Rainbow Front Bumper Stickers to Cover Up A Paint Scratch

blocks.alt: End results of the Volkswagen front bumper stickers after installation.

blocks.html:
Are you tired of staring at that unsightly scratch on your car’s front bumper? At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we understand the frustration that comes with damaged paintwork, which is why we’re here to turn your woes into wows! Our recent project for a Volkswagen owner exemplifies our commitment to quality, creativity, and customer satisfaction.

The Challenge: Paint Scratches on the Front Bumper

Our client approached us with a common issue—a noticeable scratch on the left side of their Volkswagen’s front bumper. They sought a solution that not only concealed the imperfection but also added a touch of personality to their vehicle.

The Solution: Rainbow Front Bumper Stickers

After careful consideration and consultation with our client, we proposed a unique approach: front bumper stickers with custom rainbow design. Our team custom designed and printed vibrant rainbow graphics on high-quality 3M vinyl, ensuring durability and visual appeal. To maintain symmetry and balance, we applied two rainbow vinyl wraps, one on each side of the bumper.

The Process

  1. Consultation: We began by discussing our client’s preferences, budget, and expectations. Understanding their vision allowed us to tailor our approach accordingly.
  2. Design & Printing: We outsourced our design and set up to Branding Centres designers. They crafted bespoke rainbow graphics, ensuring seamless integration with the vehicle’s aesthetics. Using cutting-edge technology, we printed the designs onto premium 3M vinyl for vibrant colors and long-lasting performance. They used Volkswagen template from Wrap Authority which made the set up and design process faster and more efficient.
  3. Installation: With precision and expertise, our installation team meticulously applied the vinyl wraps to the front bumper, ensuring a flawless finish and optimal adhesion.
  4. Quality Check: We conducted a thorough inspection to guarantee that every detail met our stringent standards, ensuring the client’s satisfaction.

Satisfying Results

The transformation was remarkable. What was once a mundane scratch became a striking feature, adding personality and flair to the Volkswagen. Our client was delighted with the end result, appreciating both the aesthetic enhancement and the seamless coverage of the original blemish.

If you’d like to see more decals and stickers we have done in the past, please visit our decals and lettering page.

If you’d like to have a similar design, we suggest contacting Branding Centres for their experienced graphic designers.

Personal car wraps can be a lot of fun. Check more of them out and get a quote.

Whether you have a four-door sedan or a two-door coupe, we can personalize your car. Draw more inspiration from our car wraps page.

Frequently Asked Questions

  1. How long does the vinyl wrap last?

Our vinyl wraps are designed to withstand the elements and maintain their appearance for years with proper care and maintenance.

  1. Can I remove the vinyl wrap without damaging the paint?

Yes, our vinyl wraps are removable and won’t damage your vehicle’s paint when properly removed by professionals.

  1. Do you offer custom designs for vinyl wraps?

Absolutely! We specialize in custom designs tailored to our clients’ preferences, ensuring a truly unique and personalized look for their vehicles.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’re not just covering scratches—we’re transforming them into opportunities for creativity and self-expression. If you’re ready to elevate your vehicle’s appearance with our front bumper stickers, contact us today for a consultation. Let’s turn your automotive dreams into reality!
